d: Bipartite. On one side escape of Christian pavilions, on the other external fortification defended by a cluster of Saracens above which I saw Argante, and Clorinda with a telescope on the right, who look into the enemy army. Far away the walls of Gierusalemme. Gofredo in a melancholy act seated in the middle of him pavilion surrounded by Princes, and Captains.
Ubaldo with rod, and fatal shield in the right. Gofredo
Gofredo, and above.
Argettes, and Clorinda descended low.
Chlorinda, and Soldiers.
Finishing of forest on the year ending in a flowered meadow with the castle of Armida. Tancredi, and Arideno.
Horseback rider, and above.
Rambaldo, and above.
Camera d'Armida alla turquoise with transparent, and flight of eight loves, which forming a pavilion in the air close the prospect of the same. Armida.
Rinaldo, who dreams of jumping out of bed with his eyes closed, and Armida.
Rinaldo Cogitabondo.
Tancredi, and Arideno chained by Rinaldo.
Tancredi, and Arideno.
Armida yearning.
Snowy hills on the daylight with illuminated pavilions above them from which awakened to the touch of enemy trumpet, come out the Militias of Gofredo, and himself with many other Captains.
Clorinda in heraldo dress. Gofredo with his Captains, and Argante on horseback that stops far between two hills assisted by a good number of Saracens.
Argans that ride up to the middle of the Christian army: arrived there descends, and for some time remains looking around without speaking. Gofredo, and sayings.
Armida garden in the form of a maze with cave in the middle. Rinaldo solo.
Armida, and Rinaldo.
They come out of the cave Tancredi, Arideno, and all the Knights imprisoned by Armida.
Armida, and Rinaldo.
Ubaldo with the rod, and fatal shield in the right, which comes out of a hedge of roses.
Rinaldo, and then Ubaldo.
Rinaldo.
Armida, coming back to find Rinaldo.

Other snowy hills covered with massacres with breach in the walls of Gierusalemme. Gofredo taking up a great shield, which holds in his arm ahead by Sigiero his shielder, and followed by many Militias.
While Guelph and the Soldiers go to attack the breach comes out Chlorinda, and Argante with Sabla to the hand followed by a big de' Saraceni.
Clorinda alone.

Seaside beach with pier, and luck in the golden ship is held at the shore waiting for Rinaldo. He is proudly fought inside the scene then comes Rinaldo, and Ubaldo with sword to the hand followed by Tancredi, Arideno, and all the Knights, whom Armida sent to Egypt.
Ubaldo and Rinaldo.
As Rinaldo walks towards the shore Armida arrives.
In order to run Ubaldo to embark with Rinaldo he is arrested by Armida.
Armida alone.
At night. Ancient military machinery in the army of Gofredo with wooden tower in the middle, above which there are the Guards. Chlorinda in black dress with visor, and closed light in the right.
Argenders coming with another closed light in the right.
Argettes.
As it burns, and the tower falls Tancredi, Arideno, and many Soldiers to whose sight Argante and Clorinda flee.
Tancredi, and Arideno.
Christian army set out with several machines to storm Gierusalemme. Gofredo, and Rinaldo.
Rinaldo, and Armida locked in a flaming globe in the air.
Armida getting to Rinaldo.
Armida, and then Ubaldo.
Ubaldo.
Gierusalemme with door in the middle, and trees from the sides. Argents on one side: Tancredi on the other without seeing each other.
Tancredi.
Clorinda's soul dressed in white over cloud, and Tancredi asleep.
Tancredi waking up leaps up with joy.
They're arid, and Tancredi.
They're lonely.

At the explosion of trumpets, and drums run to the assault of the city, in which time a great bomb in the air comes out of it, which falls into the midst of the enemies scares him first with fire, and then breaking out twelve Moors armed with Sabla, and shield that fight furiously, which finally they are killed. While Rinaldo gives the escape to many invisible Armida Soldiers arrest him by one arm.
Gofredo, Tancredi, Ubaldo, Arideno, Soldiers, and sayings.
